$comment: Exponential Desktop's factory settings (#EDE-47, the merged Settings window of the IDE look): ONE on-demand top-layer window (the menu's Settings rows open it with ede.open_document, the close button closes it), a 272 px sidebar nav on the left and the page on the right, no tile overview. The nav: This device (Display, Sound, Network, Bluetooth, Power, Themes, Keyboard, Mouse & Touchpad, Date & Time, Users, Notifications, Workspaces, Windows, Startup apps, Default apps, then the folded Coding group: Tools, Coding CLIs, Worktrees, Sessions, the IDE's This device group), Personal (Account, Devices, Security, What's new, About) and Team, headed by the shell's switcher (/shell/switcher/current; the entries as a Popover): a Local desktop shows General, Agents, Apps; a team entry shows the IDE's groups from settings-nav.json (Team, Boards, Agents, Apps), which eDE has none of yet (#EDE-54). Picking an entry here sets /settings/team only: the shell's desktop stays. Pages bind what the shell feeds: /services/<domain> (#EDE-13), /outputs, /config, /user, /shell, /date, /notifications, and /pages (#EDE-47: the layouts, Date & Time, Startup apps, Default apps, Workspaces, Windows, Mouse & Touchpad). Controls are two-way bound and call a host function with the new value: ede.service {domain, action, args}, ede.output {name, mode?, scale?}, ede.config {theme}, ede.settings {page, key, value} (compositor.toml's [keyboard] and [windows], the XDG autostart overrides, xdg-mime default, timedatectl). A setting the machine cannot apply yet is a read-only value row (Mouse & Touchpad, the workspace count, the 24-hour clock), never a dead control; the Exponential rows (Notifications' email/push, Coding, Devices, Security, a team's pages) are honest empty states until the Exponential app runs on this desktop.
